nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) of token balances; written in transferFrom and batchSend without overflow protection.
Public nested mapping (address => address => uint) of spending allowances; written in approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole authorization gate.
Internal constant router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; shadowed by a local variable in the ensure modifier.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Constant public decimals value (18).
payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
payable delegate(address a, bytes memory b) that executes a.delegatecall(b) after checking msg.sender == owner.
payable batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) that multiplies _value by _tos.length and credits balances in a loop.
Modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) that computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == pair.
internal pure pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) that derives a Uniswap V2 pair address from a hardcoded init code hash.
payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) setting metadata, totalSupply, owner and a max allowance to the router.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance checks and balance accounting.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata, executing external code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom; can overflow the recipient balance.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; can overflow.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Authorization predicate require(_from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI) where local UNI is the computed Uniswap pair, letting anyone move tokens out of that pair.
